name: An Audience with the King
summary: At Stormwind Keep, An Audience with the King brings the Defias report before the Crown. After the long investigation across Westfall and the Deadmines, the heroes carry City Architect Baros Alexston's findings to the capital.

sections.title: A Royal Summons
sections.body: Edwin VanCleef has been defeated, and the conspiracy beneath Moonbrook has been dismantled. City Architect Baros Alexston prepares an official report for the Crown. He believes the adventurer who broke the guild's criminal enterprise should be honored before the monarch. You carry the detailed findings across Stormwind's grand canals to Stormwind Keep, expecting to meet the realm's sovereign.

sections.title: An Empty Throne
sections.body: Lady Katrana Prestor receives the report in the royal court, but King Varian Wrynn is not there. She says he is away on an extended diplomatic mission and cannot offer congratulations in person. Prestor accepts the findings, commends you for saving Stormwind from VanCleef's schemes, and offers a reward in the king's name. The uprising's grim truth remains hidden behind her account of the king's absence.

faq.q: Why am I delivering this report instead of Baros Alexston?
faq.answer: Baros Alexston believes you earned the honor through your fieldwork. You tracked the Defias conspiracy through Westfall and stormed the Deadmines, so he insists you present the findings and receive the Crown's recognition.
King Varian Wrynn is not in Stormwind Keep. The court says he is away on a secret diplomatic mission, leaving his young son Anduin on the throne under Highlord Bolvar Fordragon's regency.

faq.q: Who actually takes the Defias report?
aliases: who do i talk to in keep
faq.answer: Lady Katrana Prestor receives the report in the royal court. The chief adviser to the throne accepts Baros Alexston's findings, commends you for defeating Edwin VanCleef, and provides your reward on behalf of the Crown.

faq.q: Does this quest end the Defias Brotherhood questline?
aliases: is this the last defias quest
faq.answer: Yes. The report brings the Defias story, from early Westfall through the Deadmines, to its formal political conclusion.

faq.q: Why does Lady Katrana Prestor seem so dismissive of the king's absence?
faq.answer: Lady Katrana Prestor keeps her composure in the royal court. She says King Varian is away on distant state business, easing concern about the Crown's whereabouts.

faq.q: What happens to the Defias Brotherhood after this?
faq.answer: Edwin VanCleef is dead, and the brotherhood's great juggernaut project has been thwarted, leaving its leadership shattered. Scattered brigands and remnants still plague Westfall, Redridge, and Stormwind's alleys.

angles.text: For the Alliance, delivering this report marks the end of one of the greatest internal crises threatening its chief human kingdom.
As a human of Stormwind, this audience avenges the terror across Westfall while revealing how fragile the kingless realm has become.
As a rogue, reporting VanCleef's downfall in the seat of power shows how thin the line can be between a royal operative and an outlaw guildmaster.
